name: CarrierBadge
summary: Carrier identity chip. Logo slot + name + rating (★) + vehicle type (FTL / LTL / Reefer / Flatbed) + on-time percentage. Use synthetic names (Sterling LTL, Estes Express, ODFL) per privacy rule — no real-person names.

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER use real person names in fixtures.
NEVER show a fractional OTD% (round to 1 decimal max).
NEVER stack 4+ carrier badges per row (visual overload).
